notes.title: 【 Updated on November 10, 2024 】 Finally solved the issue of lost archives!
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue where Newgame cannot be clicked without moving the cursor left and right once when entering the game title interface.
2. Rewrite the archive reading logic, now whether you exit or close the game, the archive will no longer be lost.
After a whole year of technical accumulation and exploration, when looking back at the logic of storing and reading files that I wrote in 2023, my first reaction is: What is this written about?
Then it was about thinking, trying, and changing our mindset, finally solving the complex code problem and solving the archive and file reading problem in a simple way!
^^After solving the issue of lost archives, it's so exciting.

notes.title: [Full release on December 2, 2023] Unlock all levels and animation galleries!
notes.content:
It has been a year and four months since I decided on August 15th last year to become a girl's survival journey 2.
Due to the replacement of a new game engine and the transition from RPG type to ACT, there are many production methods that are not universal and can only be gradually explored.
This is my first work to transform into an ACT game, but it won't be the last one. Although there are many flaws, the animation is colorful enough! 
[Update Content]
1. Five chapters: Starry Sky, Ocean Pavilion, Underground Research Institute, Ventilation Pipeline, and Final Passage are all unlocked.
2. Unlock animation gallery (20 pixel animation)
3. Unlock the ending: True ending+Evil ending.
Please take your time to experience it in the game. In the future, I will continue to work on this series and make it better and better.

Please continue to support me!

notes.title: April 6th [bug fix]
notes.content:
1. Adjusted the menu logic of the cat lady, and now save it before talking to the cat lady. It won't get stuck again.
2. Performed the injury turn red special effect.
3. The interaction has been optimized, and now when players press x to cancel certain interactions, no more bullets will be automatically fired.
4. Optimized archiving and reading, fixed bugs that sometimes prevented opening the saving/reading page.
5. The game installation settings have been changed, and now there will be no black screen flashing after installing the game in the traditional Chinese environment. Players who have already installed the game before, please uninstall and reinstall it!
6. Fixed a bug where the backpack could not be opened
7. Added icons for UI interface prompt buttons (backpack, switching treatment items)
8. The key position has been changed, and now players need to press "w" when investigating wall text or entering and exiting doors to avoid conflicts.
9. The crowbar attack will no longer malfunction.

notes.title: Bug fix on April 4th
notes.content:
Bug Correction
1. Fixed a bug where players would be blocked by boxes after being defeated and retried in a sewer battle
2. Fixed a bug in the 1st floor bedroom during wartime where the health was 0 and the boss grabbed it, pressing the z or x button had no response.
3. The save and read file logic has been modified. Players can now choose 'Continue Game' in the title interface. The default is to read the 1st save. Please try to save the save to the 1st as much as possible.
Other saves can also be used normally, but if the player's latest save is not number 1, other saves will not be displayed correctly. (Can be used, but without artistic effect, appears empty)
4. Reduced the attack range of ordinary variants and increased the crowbar attack range of milk tea.
5. Added gold coins obtained by killing ordinary variants.
6. Start with 7 bullets, now the bullets have become more abundant.
7. There are hidden items in the map. Please press Z more to investigate strange places.
8. Pressing F1 will provide a settings interface in the upper left corner, where you can customize the buttons.
9. Added playback speed for all text.
The next problem to be solved
1. Occasionally, when opening the archive, it may get stuck and the interface may not pop up, with unknown reasons.
2. When closing the save, players will automatically attack with a pistol, wasting a precious round of ammunition.
The attack judgment of the crowbar seems too large, and we are considering weakening it.
